Clinical Policy Bulletin: Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) - Lumbar Spine

Policy

Aetna considers MRI of the lumbar spine medically necessary when ALL of the following are met:

  • Symptoms are present for at least 6 weeks
  • Failure of conservative therapy
  • Red flags or neurologic deficit documented

Notes

Documentation requirements may vary by plan.
